reviews.author: Holly Alexander
reviews.text: I had to get the ignition switch replaced and took it over in the morning. I received a text just a few hours later that my truck was finished and ready for pickup. They are friendly and honest and dependable.

reviews.author: Sage Hernandez
reviews.text: Great job Action Automotive! Timely Very polite Decent price Will always go here And recommend anyone to come here as well They'll take care of all your needs

reviews.author: Thomas Reese
reviews.text: No complaints at all, they did exactly what I needed them to do. They were respectful and curtious. Thank you for your service.

reviews.author: Dennis Lambert
reviews.text: I took my BMW 320i to the shop because it was leaking oil I figured it was probably the oil pan. It took them 3 weeks to diagnose the problem. They told me it was the oil pan and the valve cover gasket. 3 weeks later I got the car back for a total of 6 weeks in the shop. And another $1,100 out of my pocket. They did not use floor protectors so my carpets were greasy, there is grease on the door handles and the armrest. I am OCD I keep my cars maintained meticulously. They didn't even offer me a 10% veterans discount. I will never recommend this shop to anyone not even my worst enemy.

reviews.author: Slap thepeppershaker
reviews.text: Avoid this shop if you value your time and wallet. I was billed for 6 hours of labor for a belt tensioner job that should take 2-3 hours. They then padded the bill by discharging my A/C system, which is 100% unnecessary for a 2009 Tacoma V6. Worst of all? They didn't install the idlers which is common practice and was my requests. Likely why the belt still screeches. I basically paid a "6-hour tax" for a repair that didn't work. Save yourself the headache and find a mechanic who actually knows Toyotas and follows standard labor guides. Total waste of money. Trying Yoder's next. Said to be the best around.

reviews.author: Benji Raines
reviews.text: James and his crew are excellent. Hailee up front super great. Recommend anyone give them a try you want be disappointed

reviews.author: Bryli Riddle
reviews.text: I called to get a quote on fixing my car last week and Haley gave great feedback back and was very knowledgeable! She is the sweetest! Glad she could help me, and she gave me the information I needed!

reviews.author: Chris Chavez
reviews.text: I was in a rush to an important interview when my truck suddenly started giving me issues. The team here was incredibly helpful! They quickly diagnosed the problem, explained everything clearly, and made sure I understood what was going on. Very knowledgeable, professional, and courteous throughout the whole process. I felt confident they had my back, and their quick response saved the day. Highly recommend them if you’re ever in a bind!

reviews.author: Jason McLane
reviews.text: This was the first time I used this business and it will not be the last . I have finally found a mechanic that I can trust and rely on. Everything about my experience with them was way above average. That has never happened to me and I am very impressed. I will not take my vehicle anyplace but here for any mechanical needs in the future.The employees were very friendly and responsive to every question or issue I had about my truck. They had a very positive attitude and made sure that every question I asked was answered. So overall these guys know their stuff and know how to treat customers and their prices are not outrageous and the quality of work is outstanding. They also finished earlier than they thought and kept me informed on what they were doing. And my truck is fixed. If I could I'd give them 10 gold stars. Thanks for the high quality work.

reviews.author: Beverly
reviews.text: We had rats get into the motor of my Explorer and they chewed up wires until everything was a mess. These guys went through the motor fixing everything and the Lady at the desk really went out of her way to contact and deal with the warranty insurance to make sure that they covered what was in the warranty contract. We will definitely give them all of our automotive repair work in the future.

reviews.author: Jason Rahn
reviews.text: Friendly people, excellent service!!! James and his team know their stuff and consistently provide a fantastic customer experience. They always inspect your vehicle for issues you may not be aware of which I truly appreciate as a business owner. AA saves us money by minimizing our down time and truly caring about keeping us safe on the road. Turnaround time is always quick as well. I’m very thankful to have local mechanics I can trust to get the job done right the first time, every time. Keep up the good work guys - we appreciate you so much!!!

reviews.author: Demetrice Craig
reviews.text: Had to leave a star in order to leave a review. My wife went there today for an alignment and the guy told her that she didn't need an alignment, instead she needed a front tire. She was asked to leave the car overnight as if she could pull a backup out of her pocket. She asked if she could have a tire brought to her for them to put on and the guy said it needed 4 new tires. In the end, he tried to charge her $750 for something she went in to pay $75 for. Ended up charging her $40 just to tell her she needed tires instead of an alignment. Crooks in the worst way. And all because it was a woman. Hope they're able to buy a conscience with the $40

reviews.author: Alex Rogers
reviews.text: Been going here about 2 years. Only had one bad experience that hasn't been repeated: I took my car in for evaluation on my shocks. Afterward, my key was stuck in the ignition, which has never happened before. They said I would have to get a locksmith to replace the ignition block and get a new key. My husband fixed it without a locksmith. I've been back since then with no issues.

reviews.author: Emily Pro
reviews.text: This shop did an excellent job diagnosing and treating my husband’s Nissan! We will definitely be bringing my car here for repairs as well, they were through, affordable, and the turnaround was incredible! 10/10 service!

reviews.author: Jaylend Clemmons
reviews.text: Amanda is the rudest person I have ever dealt with. I asked her to find my niece a transmission and she found one and I said it’s too much. I would keep looking and Amanda was also going to keep looking. We did not here from her for 2 weeks and my niece Megan called to see if she had found anything else. Megan told me Amanda was very rude to her also and told her she had not been looking. So I called also and talked to Amanda to see if she had found anything else. Amanda said she had not been looking. However, the last conversation was to keep looking and I would also look. Then, she said that she would look for 2 more weeks and if she didn’t find anything we would need to come get the vehicle, it was not a “grave yard” for Megan’s vehicle. We don’t need a grave yard lol we need a transmission. So I have also continued to look. I call yesterday and Amanda said she has been out sick for an entire week and has not looked. Which is understandable. She can’t help that she was sick and neither can I. I asked her if she would continue to look since she missed a week and was not able to look for one. Then she was very rude, once again. Said she would look one more day and that was it. What ever happened to looking for a transmission for the next 2 weeks? Remember you missed an entire week of work. She missed a week of work and I feel like she needs to look for a transmission throughout this week and if we can’t find one, we will move the vehicle. But she said she would look one more day- not the whole 2 weeks as promised and I would have to come get the car today. Thanks for the terrible customer service and delay of doing your job and looking for that transmissions. Amanda, your customer service is terrible and your are extremely rude! Thanks for the empty promises.FYI if you read the reviews from 6 months ago from Haley, you will also read that Amanda was rude to her. Amanda is the common denominator here.

reviews.author: Ami Moore
reviews.text: We took our 06 6.0 F-350 in for suspension issues, breaks, and high pressure oil pump replacement. Cody did an amazing in doing all the repairs needed, he went above and beyond repairing our truck. The truck runs and drives like a brand new one! Thank you Cody, you're the best!!

reviews.author: Rob English
reviews.text: Trustworthy, honest, well run repair shop. I live 800 miles away in Mass and our college aged daughter's car has been repaired by Action a number of times. Being so far away as we are, we have to rely on their analysis of the problem. and they are very efficient and well run. They adhere to their appointments; they are HONEST AND TRUSTWORTHY; they are capable and efficient; they call you back (try to get that with your Dr or anyone). I really can't say enough nice things about this shop and the nice people who have helped us overcome everything from the sudden surprise of a car that dies on the road and then won't start to an elusive electrical gremlin. They also replaced worn chassis and suspension parts. Always fair, always honest and always quality work. If I could give them 20 stars, I would, but the other references speak volumes about this well run honest repair shop. Thank you Action Automotive from the English Family.

reviews.author: Haley Meares
reviews.text: I went to have my car looked at because I was worried that even though the ride itself was fine it was making a slight noise. So I thought maybe,due to some advice of my friends that it may be the wheel bearing. I was in need of something fast for my job and my normal guy just didnt have the space to in his schedule to squeeze me in. Admittedly maybe I shouldn't have even mentioned wheel bearing, shame on me for expecting honest service I guess. Anyway they come back after looking at my car and tell me not only is it the wheel bearing going but a belt in my tire was bad. So I would need both replaced. The first lady I talked to was nice, said that the main issue was the tire and that my wheel bearing had some time left. The estimate was $440. The blonde lady, who was EXTREMELY rude and talked down to me, said the opposite. The wheel bearing needed to be replaced and the tire could wait. Thankfully my normal guy was able to squeeze me in due to a cancellation so I took it to him thinking what they told me was right. Come to find out they were wrong. My tires and bearing were fine. The only think making the noise was the tire because the tread was fine just uneven. They completely took advantage of me, or tried to, knowing I was desperate and I guess figured they could get a quick buck out of me. Not only would I pay the estimate but I would have also had to buy a rental and possibly give up a great job opportunity if couldn't find a rental in time. It's really upsetting that they were willing to cheat me out that much money for something this simple.

reviews.author: Doug Boteler
reviews.text: I manage a retail furniture store in Seneca SC. We deliver a high volume of furniture daily. So if a truck goes down we lose money. I always turn to Action Automotive when we have a breakdown. Very fast service. And are always right about diagnosis on the vehicle. If you have ever had something fixed at a car shop. Got it back and next day doing the same thing it was when you carried it the first time. You usually hear " well we missed the diagnosis. Still can fix the problem but no refund on previous service". And the people are always friendly! Lacy is always on top of things when you call. If she's unsure about something she heads the shop to find an answer. Don't think you can go wrong using these folks as your mechanic.

reviews.author: frank powell
reviews.text: I certainly made a good decision to bring my vintage truck to James and the people at action automotive. Communication was clear and the prices were fair.

reviews.author: Donald Orr
reviews.text: Water pump needed to be replaced,no other problems at this time with my sports track.they did a great job on the water pump got the truck back the next day pay my bill drove it down the road and my O.D.Light started flashing on and off. Took the truck back to action automotive,and told them what it was doing ,they said they would check it out,the next day got a call saying it was a internal problem in my transmission their price was 3,716.68.for a used transmission it was 2,624.88.the code they said they found was a po732 code, which is a incorrect Ratio code.took my truck home ,drove it up the road a few miles the code went off,truck is running fine transmission is running good .I even borrowed a tester to check codes and it came back (No codes Detected),I feel like I was lied too and was fixing to be Scammed,I don't trust this Automsotive shop,iask them if it could be the solenoids he said he energized them and they were all good that it was a internal transmission problem..if your O.D. light starts blinking,it doesn't mean you have to pay someone over 3,000 the truck reset itself and is still running good.update on sportstrac been driving it now back and forth from Greenville now for 3 weeks ,no transmission problems, truck is still running after 2 years since saying I needed a new transmission, don't trust this business they tried to ripp me off

reviews.author: steven davis
reviews.text: I recently had a rear end gear put in my mustang by Action Automotive. To sum it up it is apparent that if you are not a large company whom they have a contract with, you don't matter. The blonde lady at the service desk was as rude as they come and the owner told me that the gear will whine some. I only spoke to the owner after the work was done. I was not told this before work was done and I was never told at any point and time that there would not be any warranty. Through my research I found that if installed properly it should not whine or clunk ( which mine does) when coming to a stop. I did ask them to not test drive my car due to me not wanting some kid to wrap it around a tree. I know for a fact if you drop just the rear end off at the shop to have a gear installed, they can't test drive it without the rest of the car. Therefore if you know how to perform the work properly there is know need for a test drive. It was never not once discussed that this would void any warranty before or after the work was done. I didn't realize this until I looked at the receipt days later. I can work on my own car but when it comes to installing gears it takes some real talent to do it right. There is know one at Action Aoutomotive with this type of talent. I had to take my car to Lindsays Ring and Pinion to get it done right and I guess after all you can install a set of Ford Racing 4.10 gears without them whining and clunking. I hope this helps someone.

reviews.author: Michael McKee
reviews.text: Taken my Z3 here a few times and they have fixed it right up! They replaced a sensor and within a year it went bad again. Held true to their part/warranty clause and replaced it for free! Give them a call!

reviews.author: Randi Dickson
reviews.text: Charged my teenage son $590 for breaks and rotors on a 2012 Honda. They took advantage of a kid who is working to take care of his own car. Most expensive breaks in SC!

reviews.author: Jackie Murray
reviews.text: I was having car trouble while traveling cross country. It was late in the day and they had to keep my car overnight. They gave me a ride to and picked me up from my Airbnb. Great service.

reviews.author: Ronnie Cumbow
reviews.text: I have a work friend that took her Durango there to have the air fixed. It came with a warranty and they are charging them two days later to fix it again. That's the second person I work with that has trouble there. I won't take my car there

reviews.author: Performance Powersports & Marine
reviews.text: Action is one of the shops that we can give a 5-star rating to and we can do with confidence and integrity as we take our company trucks there for service. The Owner (James) is one of the best around.

reviews.author: robert sawicki
reviews.text: I have been taking my vehicles to Action for at least 8 years. They are always honest and will always answer any questions I have.

reviews.author: Corey Smith
reviews.text: The prices are fair. The people are friendly. Plus they got a chunky garage cat that's chill. Don't forget to use your military discount, will use again!

reviews.author: Lanie Seay
reviews.text: We were vacationing at Oconee State Park when our starter failed. We found them to be professional with quick turn around and fair pricing.

reviews.author: WM. BRAD WALDENMYER
reviews.text: Got a timely appointment and spoke with the owner directly with my expectations and listened intently to his advice and past experience. Trust this shop!!!

reviews.author: Debbie Morehead
reviews.text: Action Automotive offers excellent service by a knowledgeable profession team led by James Noel the owner.

reviews.author: Gwen Fowler
reviews.text: Zelda, the Mazda, has been very ill. The guys at action are putting her back together so we can get another 100,000 miles out of her.

reviews.author: Marie Barnes
reviews.text: Didn't go here yet but seemed to know what i was needing done on the phone when i had called and actually answered everything i needed to know. Very professional not rude

reviews.author: regina webb
reviews.text: WARNING! DO NOT TAKE YOUR CAR HERE. Rip off and after we were given the price and told car was ready, the next day the price went up 500 more dollars. Be warned!

reviews.author: Chris Corley
reviews.text: The staff are very knowledgeable, competent, and friendly. Definitely one of the best, in the business.
